detail.longDescription: Happy to announce I've relaese v1.0.0 of my # Python # LibroFM utility Over the weekend I did a lot of refactoring of the code. There's much better test coverage. The main thing I'm happy about, though, is I changed the "download" to "sync" and it works much better. Specifically, it tracks what's already been downloaded and makes sure not to get those again (unless you want it to, of course). My plan is to set it on a cron to check periodically and automatically grab new books for me. You can snag the code here: https:// codeberg.org/bfordham/librofm Or run `pip install librofm` # audiobooks # selfhosted
